objective.name: continuity.stranded
objective.description: Finds the continuities that cannot go on by themselves: a run that died, or work waiting with no run to take it. It only reads.

#root.role: Examine the continuities of the canonical Structure and name those whose run died or whose work is waiting with no run to take it.

continuity_ids._comment: Optional. Limits the examination to these continuities. Absent: every continuity of the Structure.

transformation_contract.morphing: The continuities of the Structure become the identifiers of those that need a run, each with the reason.
invariants: Examining a continuity only reads its state: nothing is written.
A continuity is stranded when its runtime says running or waiting for a run that is not alive in this process.
A continuity is stranded when it is idle and holds a pending message that its journal holds, a current message or an active wait group.
An archived or suspended continuity, and an idle continuity with no work, is never stranded.
The continuities are taken from the canonical Structure continuities, in its order; when continuity_ids is given, only these are examined.
success: continuity_ids lists the stranded continuities and reasons says why for each.
failure: Fails if the Structure of the continuities cannot be read.
A continuity whose Matters cannot be read is skipped and named in skipped; it does not stop the others.
notes: Executed by the agentic_core Python wrapper.
Alive means alive in this process (substrate liveness): after a restart no run is alive, so every running or waiting continuity is stranded.
Contract only: the grain of its resolution is left open.
